narrative_purpose: Full-bleed atmospheric mood layer behind the chapter: a vast, dim Pandoran nightscape that sets the feeling of a living world built, all the way down, from the same chemistry as our own.
subject: An ultra-wide panoramic Pandoran night vista from a high vantage: an endless forested basin far below threaded with faint rivers of bioluminescent cyan and teal, drifting banks of luminous spore-fog, no single bright focal subject — only the slow low glow of a living landscape under a dark sky.
scene: A high ridge overlook at deep night, the basin receding for miles into layered atmospheric haze, the great dim unlit bulk of Polyphemus implied low on the far horizon.
camera: An extreme wide, high-vantage panoramic view, distant and contemplative, horizon low.
light: Very low overall; scattered faint bioluminescent glows in the far forest as the only light, deep indigo-teal atmosphere swallowing the distance, no bright highlights.
palette: Dominated by void-indigo and deep teal, with only sparse dim cyan glow far below; deliberately dark and low-contrast.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, atmospheric, hand-painted depth.
detail_level: Soft and low-contrast throughout; everything dissolving into atmospheric haze, no crisp focal element.
composition: Wide horizontal panorama with deep atmospheric layers, low horizon, vast dark sky above, the glow kept faint and distant — built to sit behind text.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette, dark and atmospheric, intentionally low-contrast as a background layer; no bright subject to compete with overlaid text.
